verdict.rationale: Puzzle is general-ledger accounting software, so period locking is an applicable axis. The evidence covers AI Close month-end automation, reconciliation, and voiding/reversing entries when manual journal entries are edited, but nothing documents locking closed periods or requiring an explicit reopening. Reversing entries on edit is an adjacent audit behavior, not a period lock.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can lock closed periods so prior-period numbers cannot change without an explicit reopening
